title: Nice midcentury look, but I got a blue chair...
text: Nice midcentury look, but I got a blue chair.... Hmm, I didn't get what I ordered. I got a blue chair with fabric, and the legs are nothing like the metal legs in the picture. I can still use it, it looks pretty high quality. It would have been more of a midcentury look to it if the chair was actually brown. Both options are brown, there is no blue option, yet I got a blue one. Go figure... 3-Stars.
